<!-- smg-doc-sync:f5c25393c9111a90f02207896979a07e27f1baf1:reasoning-effort-native-off-words -->

## Concern

Update the gRPC thinking-toggle documentation for chat templates that toggle thinking through their own `reasoning_effort` on/off words (Hy4-style, `high`/`no_think`). On main (commit f5c25393c9111a90f02207896979a07e27f1baf1; verified in current model_gateway/src/routers/grpc/utils/parsers.rs `native_effort_thinking` lines 207–223 and `resolve_thinking_pref` lines 232–242, and crates/tokenizer/src/chat_template.rs `REASONING_EFFORT_ON_VALUES`/`REASONING_EFFORT_OFF_VALUES` lines 61–63 with the write-back at lines 1143–1150), such templates are read by their own words alone: only the template's off word (`no_think`) turns thinking off, and any other effort value — including the protocol's `none`/`minimal` — turns thinking on (their default) and takes precedence over `thinking.type` and the generic effort fallback. Renderers with native effort levels but no off words (DeepSeek V4/V4.1, Kimi-K3) keep the documented `none`/`minimal` = off behavior. The PR corrects step 2 of the thinking-decision list in reference/api/openai.md and the "Thinking on or off" bullet in concepts/architecture/grpc-pipeline.md (which also gains the `reasoning_effort` on/off-word entry in the list of keys SMG writes). Both pages describe current behavior without release claims, so no release qualifier is added or removed.

## Evidence

Verified against current source: parsers.rs native_effort_thinking (lines 207–223) makes templates with their own reasoning_effort off words (Hy4-style) read the effort by those words alone — only `no_think` turns thinking off, every other value (including protocol `none`/`minimal`) resolves to Some(true) because detect_thinking_toggle (chat_template.rs 96–105) always assigns DefaultOn to ReasoningEffort-key templates; resolve_thinking_pref/resolve_user_thinking (lines 232–242, 327–339) rank this above thinking.type and the generic effort fallback, confirmed by the hy_v4 test (line 973: none → Some(true)). Renderers without off words keep the documented none/minimal=off behavior (lines 210–214), which the patch correctly preserves for DeepSeek V4/V4.1/Kimi-K3. The write-back of the template's on/off word under the reasoning_effort key (chat_template.rs 1143–1150) supports the grpc-pipeline.md key-list addition, which is part of the same single mechanism, not a second concern. Current docs contradict this behavior (openai.md line 193; grpc-pipeline.md line 175), so it is not already documented. The patch edits only existing content pages, makes no release claims, and removes no release-specific warnings; the docs repo is nightly-synced to current source with no versioned-docs convention, so describing current behavior without a release qualifier matches house style.

Source change: https://github.com/smg-project/smg/commit/f5c25393c9111a90f02207896979a07e27f1baf1

plan.reason: The commit only modifies scripts/ci_install_tokenspeed.sh, an internal CI-only install script (verified: its header scopes it to CI on k8s-runner-gpu nodes and the CI Docker image). It pins nvidia-cutlass-dsl==4.5.2 via UV_CONSTRAINT/PIP_CONSTRAINT and adds diagnostic provenance output to fix a transitive-dependency regression (cute.core.ThrMma removed in cutlass 4.6.0) that broke `import tokenspeed` in CI runs. No gateway code, configuration surface, API, metrics, or documented user workflow changes. The single docs mention of the script (src/lib/content/getting-started/kv-events-cache-aware.md line 132) is an informational pointer that remains accurate; no docs page documents or should document CI dependency pins.

The commit exclusively modifies internal CI benchmark infrastructure: .github/workflows/nightly-tau2.yml (new dispatch inputs request_timeout/run_timeout, a num_tasks cap on one matrix leg, a PYTHONPATH shim export, summary-heading wording), a new scripts/tau2/costmap_shim/sitecustomize.py that registers the served model at $0 cost in LiteLLM purely to silence log spam inside the benchmark subprocess, timeout/report-format changes in the internal harness scripts/tau2/run_ab.py, and tests under scripts/tests/. Verified against current source: run_ab.py remains an internal τ²-bench A/B CI driver (and has evolved further on main). No gateway runtime code, configuration option, API, metric, or documented developer workflow changes. Verified against current docs: the Benchmarks section of contributing/development.md covers only Criterion benchmarks, benchmark-* workflows, and the advisory genai-bench job; searches for "tau2" and "run_ab" across all docs pages return nothing, so no existing passage is affected and no documented behavior changed.

Every user-facing behavior in commit 8155b1fd is already covered by current docs, verified against current source. (1) The engine-specific HTTP load path (vLLM/SGLang scraped from Prometheus /metrics when no native load route answers) exists in model_gateway/src/worker/monitor.rs (fetch_http_load dispatch, lines 646–705, 744–795) and is documented in concepts/reliability/overload-protection.md lines 95–99 ("HTTP vLLM or SGLang without a native route | GET /metrics | ... KV usage from vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc (vllm:gpu_cache_usage_perc on older vLLM) or SGLang token_usage (sglang: or sglang_ prefix). A scrape without the KV usage gauge counts as no report."), concepts/routing/load-balancing.md line 93 ("falling back to the engine's Prometheus /metrics (SGLang, vLLM) when that route does not answer"), and concepts/routing/cache-aware.md line 228. (2) The metric-name variants and the KV-usage-gauge requirement are matched verbatim by the same overload-protection passage. (3) The manager.rs change gating the /get_loads workers[].load scalar to -1 is superseded: WorkerLoadInfo no longer exists in current source and /get_loads is a deprecated alias of /loads; reference/api/admin.md line 800 documents the v1.11.0 response-shape change and line 790 documents that num_used_tokens/max_total_num_tokens are 0 for workers read from Prometheus /metrics. (4) The DP-rank cache gating on has_absolute_token_data (monitor.rs lines 1109–1124) is an internal correctness fix preventing ratio-only snapshots from collapsing DP routing onto rank 0; docs make no contrary claim and load-balancing.md line 265 already notes metrics-scraped engines report no token counts. No doc edit is needed.

The commit is a defect fix in the PD HTTP streaming relay, verified in current source (model_gateway/src/routers/http/pd_router.rs lines 1561–1568 and fn chunk_contains_done_event at line 1828): the stream terminator is now detected only as a line-anchored, delimiter-complete `data: [DONE]` SSE event, and merge_streaming_logprobs skips only an exact `[DONE]` sentinel instead of any payload containing that substring. Previously, payload text containing the bytes `data: [DONE]` (e.g., inside tool-call arguments) falsely terminated a live stream. The fix introduces no new configuration, API field, metric, or behavioral contract — it makes the code conform to the SSE contract the current docs already state (src/lib/content/reference/api/openai.md lines 301/308 show streams ending with a standalone `data: [DONE]` event), and no existing page (including concepts/routing/pd-disaggregation.md's "Failures, Cancellation, and Streaming" section, lines 140–147) describes the old buggy substring detection, so there is no incorrect passage to fix and nothing new for users to configure or observe beyond bug-free behavior.
